title: Light-switchable swarming of biohybrid microrobots.
abstract: Controlling collective behavior in the microscale is essential for advancing autonomous robotic systems in complex environments. While biohybrid microrobotic swarms offer considerable promise for targeted therapeutic and remediation applications, their programmable assembly and collective behavior remain challenging.
